title: Technical Writer
description: Learn how to write developer docs, API references, tutorials, release notes, diagrams, and docs-as-code portfolios.

tree.name: Writing Foundations
tree.description: Write clearly for users, developers, support teams, and product stakeholders.

children.name: Clarity and Structure
children.description: Use audience analysis, active voice, headings, examples, task orientation, and plain language.

children.name: Editing and Review
children.description: Edit for accuracy, consistency, tone, accessibility, terminology, and maintainability.

tree.name: Developer Basics
tree.description: Understand enough web, APIs, Git, command line, and JSON to document technical workflows confidently.

children.name: Markdown and Git
children.description: Write Markdown, review pull requests, manage branches, and collaborate with engineers.

children.name: API Concepts
children.description: Learn HTTP, endpoints, auth, request/response examples, errors, SDKs, and OpenAPI.

children.name: Practice: Rewrite a Bad Doc
children.description: Turn unclear instructions into a tested how-to guide with prerequisites, steps, verification, and troubleshooting.

tree.name: Documentation Types
tree.description: Create tutorials, how-to guides, concept docs, reference docs, changelogs, and release notes.

children.name: API Reference
children.description: Document endpoints, schemas, examples, errors, auth, pagination, rate limits, and generated refs.

children.name: Tutorials and How-to Guides
children.description: Write reliable step-by-step docs with prerequisites, verification steps, troubleshooting, and outcomes.

tree.name: Docs-as-Code and Portfolio
tree.description: Publish versioned docs sites, automate checks, draw diagrams, and build a portfolio from real samples.

children.name: Static Docs Sites
children.description: Build docs navigation, search, versioning, content reuse, redirects, and contribution guides.

children.name: Docs Metrics and Maintenance
children.description: Track search failures, broken links, stale pages, support deflection, feedback loops, and content ownership.

children.name: Project: Developer Docs Portal
children.description: Document a small API or open-source tool with quickstart, concepts, API reference, diagrams, and release notes.
